description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeTargetHTTPSProxy via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeTargetHTTPSProxy spec.

certificateManagerCertificates.description: URLs to certificate manager certificate resources that are used to authenticate connections between users and the load balancer. Currently, you may specify up to 15 certificates. Certificate manager certificates do not apply when the load balancing scheme is set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED. sslCertificates and certificateManagerCertificates fields cannot be defined together.

items.description: CertificateManagerCertificateRef is a reference to a CertificateManagerCertificate. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CertificateManagerCertificate resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/certificates/{{certificateID}}".

name.description: The name of a CertificateManagerCertificate resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a CertificateManagerCertificate resource.

certificateMapRef.description: A reference to the CertificateMap resource uri that identifies a certificate map associated with the given target proxy. This field can only be set for global target proxies. This field is only supported for EXTERNAL and EXTERNAL_MANAGED load balancing schemes. For INTERNAL_MANAGED, use certificateManagerCertificates instead. sslCertificates and certificateMap fields cannot be defined together. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CertificateManagerCertificateMap resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/global/certificateMaps/{{certificateMapID}}".

name.description: The name of a CertificateManagerCertificateMap resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a CertificateManagerCertificateMap resource.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of this resource.

httpKeepAliveTimeoutSec.description: Immutable. Specifies how long to keep a connection open, after completing a response, while there is no matching traffic (in seconds). If an HTTP keepalive is not specified, a default value (610 seconds) will be used. For Global external HTTP(S) load balancer, the minimum allowed value is 5 seconds and the maximum allowed value is 1200 seconds. For Global external HTTP(S) load balancer (classic), this option is not available publicly.

location.description: Location represents the geographical location of the ComputeTargetHTTPSProxy. Specify a region name or "global" for global resources. Reference: GCP definition of regions/zones (https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones/)

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

proxyBind.description: Immutable. This field only applies when the forwarding rule that references this target proxy has a loadBalancingScheme set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED.

quicOverride.description: Specifies the QUIC override policy for this resource. This determines whether the load balancer will attempt to negotiate QUIC with clients or not. Can specify one of NONE, ENABLE, or DISABLE. If NONE is specified, Google manages whether QUIC is used. Default value: "NONE" Possible values: ["NONE", "ENABLE", "DISABLE"].

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

serverTlsPolicyRef.description: Immutable. A URL referring to a networksecurity.ServerTlsPolicy resource that describes how the proxy should authenticate inbound traffic. serverTlsPolicy only applies to a global TargetHttpsProxy attached to globalForwardingRules with the loadBalancingScheme set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED or EXTERNAL or EXTERNAL_MANAGED. For details which ServerTlsPolicy resources are accepted with INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED and which with EXTERNAL, EXTERNAL_MANAGED loadBalancingScheme consult ServerTlsPolicy documentation. If left blank, communications are not encrypted. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/serverTlsPolicies/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `name` field of a `NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy` resource.

name.description: The name of a NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a NetworkSecurityServerTLSPolicy resource.

sslCertificates.description: A list of ComputeSSLCertificate resources that are used to authenticate connections between users and the load balancer. At least one SSL certificate must be specified.

items.description: A reference to a ComputeSSLCertificate resource. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: string of the format `projects/{{project}}/global/sslCertificates/{{value}}` or `projects/{{project}}/regions/{{region}}/sslCertificates/{{value}}`, where {{value}} is the `name` field of a `ComputeSSLCertificate` resource.

name.description: The name of a ComputeSSLCertificate resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSSLCertificate resource.

sslPolicyRef.description: A reference to the ComputeSSLPolicy resource that will be associated with the ComputeTargetHTTPSProxy resource. If not set, the ComputeTargetHTTPSProxy resource will not have any SSL policy configured. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeSSLPolicy resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/sslPolicies/{{sslPolicyID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/sslPolicies/{{sslPolicyID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeSSLPolicy resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeSSLPolicy resource.

urlMapRef.description: A reference to the ComputeURLMap resource that defines the mapping from URL to the BackendService. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeURLMap resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/urlMaps/{{urlMapID}}" or "projects/{{projectID}}/regions/{{region}}/urlMaps/{{urlMapID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeURLMap resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeURLMap resource.
